definition: Content depicting sexual behavior, nudity, or sexual themes.

risk_levels.LOW: Romance, kissing, non-sexual nudity in art or medical contexts.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Suggestive themes, sexual innuendo, revealing clothing in entertainment contexts.
risk_levels.HIGH: Pornography, explicit sexual acts, non-consensual sexual content.

definition: Content promoting the sale or use of weapons, firearms, and ammunition.

risk_levels.LOW: Fictional weapons in gaming/movies, historical museums, water guns.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Hunting, sport shooting, reviews of legal firearms with safety context.
risk_levels.HIGH: Unregulated sale of firearms, instructions on making 3D printed guns, promotion of weaponized violence.

category: Crime & Harmful Acts to Individuals and Society
definition: Content depicting illegal activities, self-harm, or harm to others.

risk_levels.LOW: Crime dramas, news reporting on crime statistics, fictional villains.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Graphic depictions of crime in entertainment, discussions on controversial laws.
risk_levels.HIGH: Promotion of illegal acts, instructions for crime, real-world self-harm or suicide promotion.

definition: Content displaying death, gore, physical injury, or military combat.

risk_levels.LOW: Abstract discussions of mortality, fictional battles without gore, memorial services.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: News footage of conflict zones (blurred), medical procedures (educational), stylized action violence.
risk_levels.HIGH: Graphic real-world gore, beheadings, torture, mutilation, unedited war footage.

definition: Content promoting or enabling the unauthorized distribution of copyrighted material.

risk_levels.LOW: Discussions about copyright law, reviews of streaming services.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Debates on internet freedom, news about piracy crackdowns.
risk_levels.HIGH: Links to torrent sites, cracked software downloads, stream ripping tools.

definition: Content that promotes violence or discrimination against protected groups.

risk_levels.LOW: Educational content about civil rights, condemnation of hate speech.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Reporting on hate groups, fictional antagonists using slurs (condemned by narrative).
risk_levels.HIGH: Direct hate speech, racial slurs, promotion of genocide, recruitment for hate groups.

definition: Content containing offensive language, vulgar gestures, or scatological humor.

risk_levels.MEDIUM: Strong language (f-bombs) in music or movies, adult comedy.
risk_levels.HIGH: Relentless profanity, extremely vulgar insults, scatological perversion.

category: Illegal Drugs / Tobacco / E-Cigarettes / Alcohol / Gambling
definition: Content depicting or promoting the use of regulated substances.

risk_levels.LOW: Anti-drug PSAs, news on drug policy, fictional depiction with negative consequences.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: Depiction of legal substance use (alcohol/tobacco) in entertainment, cannabis news.
risk_levels.HIGH: Sale of illegal drugs, instructions on manufacturing drugs, glamorization of addiction.

definition: Content that is deceptive, irrelevant, or technically harmful (malware).

risk_levels.MEDIUM: Misleading thumbnails, aggressive multi-level marketing (MLM) schemes.
risk_levels.HIGH: Phishing links, malware downloads, scams, bot-generated gibberish.

definition: Content promoting, supporting, or recruiting for terrorist organizations.

risk_levels.LOW: Memorials for victims, educational history of conflicts.
risk_levels.MEDIUM: News reporting on terrorist attacks, fictional plots involving terrorism.
risk_levels.HIGH: Propaganda videos, recruitment messages, praise for terrorist acts, hostage videos.

definition: Content related to intensely debated social topics (politics, religion, rights).

risk_levels.LOW: Factual reporting, balanced debates, educational civics.
risk_levels.HIGH: Disinformation, inflammatory polarization, conspiracy theories designed to incite panic.
